# action.docker_image_load

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: action. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Loads images from a local tar archive into the daemon, like `docker load`. The archive is what `docker save` or the `docker_image_save` action writes; the loaded image names are reported as progress. The images are not tracked in state.

Actions need Terraform >= 1.14. They keep no state: they run when a
resource's `lifecycle { action_trigger { ... } }` fires, or on demand with
`terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_image_load.<name>`. Arguments go inside
the action's `config` block.

## Usage

```terraform
action "docker_image_load" "<name>" {
  config {
    # arguments below
  }
}

# Run it: lifecycle { action_trigger { events = [after_create] actions = [action.docker_image_load.<name>] } }
# on a resource, or: terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_image_load.<name>
```

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | `string` | required |  |  | Local path of the image archive (optionally gzip/bzip2/xz compressed). `~` expands to the home directory. |

## Example

```terraform
resource "terraform_data" "bundle" {
  input = filesha256("${path.module}/images.tar")

  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create, after_update]
      actions = [action.docker_image_load.bundle]
    }
  }
}

# Loads every image in an archive written by `docker save`. On demand:
#   terraform apply -invoke=action.docker_image_load.bundle
action "docker_image_load" "bundle" {
  config {
    path = "${path.module}/images.tar"
  }
}
```
